Begin your answer with exactly one line: "Verdict: yes", "Verdict: no", or "Verdict: cannot tell from this trace". Then answer the question.
answer:
Verdict: no

By CPU time, the sink threads are fairly evenly loaded: sink-2 (TID 642975) used 6.926 s, the most, while sink-3 (TID 642976) used 6.341 s, the least—a ratio of about **1.09×**, not 2×. The other sinks were sink-0 (TID 642973) at 6.844 s and sink-1 (TID 642974) at 6.800 s. Their reported user-mode times show the same pattern.

This measures CPU effort, not the number of items each sink processed; the results do not include per-sink throughput or item counts.
